    similarity, difference, analogy_boundary, common_mistakes_json
) VALUES
    ('php', 'capability', 'go.functions-errors', 'v1',
     'Both ecosystems make failures part of application control flow.',
     'Go returns errors explicitly instead of relying on exceptions for ordinary failures.',
     'An error value is not an exception object and does not unwind the stack automatically.',
     '["ignoring returned errors","recreating exception-style control flow"]'),
    ('php', 'capability', 'go.interfaces-composition', 'v1',
     'Interfaces describe substitutable behavior at a boundary.',
     'Go interfaces are satisfied implicitly and are usually kept small by the consumer.',
     'Implicit satisfaction does not mean every large class contract should become one large Go interface.',
     '["porting inheritance hierarchies","declaring interfaces beside implementations"]');
